title: i-Tail acquires US pet treat manufacturer Phelps Pet Products
summary: Thai pet food manufacturer i-Tail Corporation has acquired Phelps Pet Products, an Illinois-based contract manufacturer of pet treats, for an enterprise value of $160 million (€139M). According to the company, the deal e…
ai_summary: i-Tail Corporation has acquired Phelps Pet Products, a contract manufacturer of pet treats in Illinois, for an enterprise value of $160 million. The acquisition expands i-Tail's presence in the U.S. pet food market.
